blocks.text: Yeh woh glands hain jo sperms mein fluids (mayi) mila kar semen banate hain:

items: Do seminal vesicles hain. Har gland ek nali ke zariye vas deferens mein fructose (sugar) se bhara fluid dalta hai. Yeh fluid sperm ko tawanai (energy) deta hai.

Prostate gland urinary bladder ke bilkul neeche hota hai. Yeh naram aur spongy hai aur semen ka taqreeban 25-30% fluid banata hai (sab se zyada, taqreeban 60%, seminal vesicles banati hain). Semen sperms aur seminal vesicles aur prostate gland ke fluids ka mixture hai.

Do chhote bulbourethral glands hain. Yeh saaf fluid chhorte hain jo sperm ke guzarne ke liye urethra ko chikna (lubricate) karta hai aur sperms ko zinda rehne ke liye hifazati neutral (na tezabi na alkaline) mahol deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke prostate gland semen ka taqreeban 60% fluid banata hai. Yeh durust nahin: semen ka sab se bara hissa, taqreeban 60%, seminal vesicles banati hain, aur prostate gland taqreeban 25-30% banata hai. Oopar sahi adad likhe gaye hain.
